blocks.text: It takes ... — biror ishga ketadigan vaqt

O'zbek tilida vaqt sarfi haqida «**ketadi**» fe'li bilan gapiramiz: «Samarqandga poyezdda ikki soat **ketadi**», «Bu ishga butun kunim **ketdi**». Ingliz tilida buning uchun **take** fe'li ishlatiladi va gap ko'pincha **it** bilan boshlanadi: **It takes** two hours **to get** to Samarkand by train. Qolip: **It + take + vaqt + to + fe'l**. Bu yerda **it** — 39-darsdagi «rasmiy ega»: u hech narsani anglatmaydi, faqat ega o'rnini to'ldiradi, chunki ingliz gapida ega bo'lishi shart.

rows: It **takes** ten minutes to walk to the park.
It **took** three hours to get home.
It**'ll take** a week to finish the work.
It**'s taken** two years to build the bridge.
It **didn't take** long to find the hotel.

items.text: It **takes** about an hour to get to the airport.
It **took** a long time to find the right address.
It **won't take** long to make some tea.

blocks.text: Savol: How long does it take ...?

«Qancha vaqt ketadi?» savoli: **How long + does / did / will + it + take + to + fe'l?** So'z tartibi 44-darsdagi odatiy savol: yordamchi fe'l (**does**, **did**, **will**) egadan (**it**) oldin, take esa asosiy shaklda: How long **does** it **take** to cook plov? How long **did** it **take** to get there? Qisqa javoblar: **About** an hour. / **Not long**. / **Ages!** («juda uzoq»).

items.text: **How long does it take** to fly from Tashkent to Istanbul?
**How long did it take** to get to the stadium? — Not long, about ten minutes.
items.translation: Stadionga borishga **qancha vaqt ketdi**? — Ko'p emas, o'n daqiqacha.

blocks.text: Kimga: It takes me ..., It took Aziz ...

Vaqt kimga ketishini aytish uchun take dan keyin odam qo'yiladi — olmosh bo'lsa, to'ldiruvchi shaklda (me, you, him, her, us, them — → 59-dars): It takes **me** forty minutes to get to work. It took **Aziz** a year to learn Turkish. O'zbekchada bu egalik yoki qaratqich bilan beriladi: «Ishga borish**im**ga qirq daqiqa ketadi», «Aziz**ning** turk tilini o'rganishiga bir yil ketdi».

rows: It takes **me** an hour to cook dinner.
Kechki ovqat pishirishimga bir soat ketadi.
It took **her** a week to read the book.
It'll take **us** two days to get there.
U yerga yetib borishimizga ikki kun ketadi.
How long does it take **you** to get to work?
How long did it take **Tom** to find a flat?
Tomning kvartira topishiga qancha vaqt ketdi?

items.text: It **takes me** twenty minutes to walk to school.
It **took Madina** three months to find a new job.
items.translation: Madinaning yangi ish topishiga uch oy **ketdi**.

items.text: How long **did it take you** to learn English?

blocks.text: Ega faqat **it** emas, harakatning o'zi ham bo'lishi mumkin: **The flight takes** seven hours. **The journey took** longer than we thought. **Good plov takes** two hours. Bunda «to + fe'l» qismi kerak bo'lmaydi. Farqiga e'tibor bering: **How long is** the film? — filmning o'zi qancha davom etadi; **How long does it take** to get to the cinema? — u yerga borishga qancha vaqt ketadi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «It needs two hours to get there.» → **It takes two hours to get there.**; «How long it takes?» → **How long does it take?** (savolda does); «It takes me two hours for get there.» → **... to get there.**; «It took to me an hour.» → **It took me an hour.** (me dan oldin predlog yo'q); «I need one hour for come.» → **It takes me an hour to come.**

Eslab qolish: o'zbekcha «... ga ... **ketadi**» = inglizcha **It takes** + vaqt + **to** + fe'l. Odamni qo'shmoqchi bo'lsangiz — take dan keyin: It takes **me** ... . Savolni How long bilan boshlang va **does it take** ni yodlab oling.
Bog'liq darslar: it — rasmiy ega (It's cold, It's 5 km) — → 39-dars; How long ...? va boshqa How savollari — → 47-dars; How long have you ...? (qachondan beri) — → 18-dars; to + fe'l — → 52-dars.

items: Vaqt sarfi: **It takes / took / will take + vaqt + to + fe'l**.
Odam bilan: It takes **me** / **her** / **Aziz** + vaqt + to + fe'l.
Savol: **How long does / did / will it take** (you) **to** ...?
Inkor: It **doesn't take** long. / It **didn't take** long.
Ega harakatning o'zi ham bo'lishi mumkin: **The flight takes** seven hours.

examples.title: **It takes** ... **to** ...: journeys
examples.description: Yo'l va sayohatga ketadigan vaqt: **It takes + vaqt + to + fe'l**. O'zbekchada: «... ga ... **ketadi**». Gap boshida ko'pincha joy yoki transport: By plane, From our house.

sentences.text: **It takes** about two hours to get to Samarkand by fast train.
sentences.translation: Tezyurar poyezdda Samarqandga yetib borishga taxminan ikki soat **ketadi**.

sentences.text: From our house **it takes** ten minutes to walk to the metro.
sentences.translation: Uyimizdan metrogacha piyoda o'n daqiqa **ketadi**.

sentences.text: By plane **it takes** seven hours to fly from Tashkent to London.
sentences.translation: Samolyotda Toshkentdan Londonga uchishga yetti soat **ketadi**.

sentences.text: On a good day **it only takes** twenty minutes to drive to the airport.
sentences.translation: Yaxshi kunda aeroportga mashinada borishga bor-yo'g'i yigirma daqiqa **ketadi**.

sentences.text: **It takes** a long time to cross the city in the rush hour.
sentences.translation: Tig'iz soatda shaharni kesib o'tishga ko'p vaqt **ketadi**.

sentences.text: Usually **it takes** about forty minutes to get to the centre by bus.
sentences.translation: Odatda markazga avtobusda borishga qirq daqiqacha **ketadi**.

sentences.text: In winter **it takes** longer because the roads are icy.
sentences.translation: Qishda ko'proq vaqt **ketadi**, chunki yo'llar muz bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Bukhara is quite far. **It takes** about six hours by car.
sentences.translation: Buxoro ancha uzoq. Mashinada olti soatcha **ketadi**.

sentences.text: Without traffic, **it takes** fifteen minutes to get to Tom's house.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlik bo'lmasa, Tomning uyiga borishga o'n besh daqiqa **ketadi**.

sentences.text: Does it take long to get there? — No, **it takes** five minutes on foot.
sentences.translation: U yerga borishga ko'p vaqt ketadimi? — Yo'q, piyoda besh daqiqa **ketadi**.

examples.title: **How long does it take** ...?
examples.description: Savol: **How long does it take + to + fe'l?** — «... ga qancha vaqt ketadi?» Savol so'zidan keyin odatiy tartib: does + it + take.

sentences.text: **How long does it take** to get to the city centre from here?
sentences.translation: Bu yerdan shahar markazigacha borishga **qancha vaqt ketadi**?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **how long does it take** to walk to the castle?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, qal'agacha piyoda borishga **qancha vaqt ketadi**?

sentences.text: **How long does it take** to cook plov? — About two hours.
sentences.translation: Palov pishirishga **qancha vaqt ketadi**? — Ikki soatcha.

sentences.text: Roughly **how long does it take** to learn to drive?
sentences.translation: Mashina haydashni o'rganishga taxminan **qancha vaqt ketadi**?

sentences.text: By train, **how long does it take** to get to Manchester?
sentences.translation: Poyezdda Manchesterga borishga **qancha vaqt ketadi**?

sentences.text: I'd like to learn Chinese. **How long does it take** to learn the basics?
sentences.translation: Xitoy tilini o'rganmoqchiman. Asoslarini o'rganishga **qancha vaqt ketadi**?

sentences.text: **Does it take** long to get a visa? — Usually about two weeks.
sentences.translation: Viza olish uchun **ko'p vaqt ketadimi**? — Odatda ikki haftacha.

sentences.text: So **how long does it take** for the paint to dry?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, bo'yoq qurishiga **qancha vaqt ketadi**?

sentences.text: From Tashkent to Bukhara by plane — **how long does it take**?
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Buxoroga samolyotda — **qancha vaqt ketadi**?

sentences.text: Tell me, **how long does it usually take** to repair a phone screen?
sentences.translation: Ayting-chi, telefon ekranini ta'mirlashga odatda **qancha vaqt ketadi**?

examples.title: **It took** ...: the past
examples.description: O'tgan zamonda — **It took** + vaqt + to + fe'l: «... ketdi». Inkori: **It didn't take** long — «ko'p vaqt ketmadi».

sentences.text: **It took** ages to find a parking space this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab mashina qo'yishga joy topishga juda ko'p vaqt **ketdi**.

sentences.text: The flight was delayed, so **it took** twelve hours to get home.
sentences.translation: Reys kechiktirildi, shuning uchun uyga yetib borishga o'n ikki soat **ketdi**.

sentences.text: In the past, **it took** weeks to travel from Bukhara to Samarkand by camel.
sentences.translation: Qadimda Buxorodan Samarqandga tuyada borishga bir necha hafta **ketgan**.

sentences.text: Yesterday **it took** me two hours to do my homework.
sentences.translation: Kecha uy vazifamni qilishga ikki soat vaqtim **ketdi**.

sentences.text: There was a long queue at the bank, so **it took** forty minutes to pay a bill.
sentences.translation: Bankda uzun navbat bor edi, shuning uchun bitta to'lovga qirq daqiqa **ketdi**.

sentences.text: **It took** Madina six months to save money for the trip.
sentences.translation: Madinaning sayohatga pul yig'ishiga olti oy **ketdi**.

sentences.text: Last week the builders finished our kitchen. **It took** them a month.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta quruvchilar oshxonamizni tugatishdi. Bunga ularning bir oy vaqti **ketdi**.

sentences.text: Was the exam difficult? — Yes, **it took** me the whole two hours.
sentences.translation: Imtihon qiyinmidi? — Ha, butun ikki soat vaqtim **ketdi**.

sentences.text: Luckily, **it didn't take** long to fix the car.
sentences.translation: Yaxshiyamki, mashinani tuzatishga ko'p vaqt **ketmadi**.

sentences.text: After the storm **it took** a week to repair all the roofs in the village.
sentences.translation: Bo'rondan keyin qishloqdagi barcha tomlarni ta'mirlashga bir hafta **ketdi**.

examples.title: **It takes me** / **It takes her** ...
examples.description: Vaqt kimga ketishi: **It takes + odam (me, him, her, us, Aziz) + vaqt + to + fe'l**. O'zbekchada: «borish**im**ga», «tayyorlanish**i**ga».

sentences.text: **It takes me** forty minutes to get to work by bus.
sentences.translation: Ishga avtobusda borishimga qirq daqiqa **ketadi**.

sentences.text: My sister is very quick. **It takes her** five minutes to get ready.
sentences.translation: Singlim juda chaqqon. Tayyorlanishiga besh daqiqa **ketadi**.

sentences.text: On Mondays **it takes me** longer because there's more traffic.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kunlari ko'proq vaqtim **ketadi**, chunki tirbandlik ko'proq.

sentences.text: Aziz lives next to his office, so **it only takes him** two minutes to get there.
sentences.translation: Aziz ofisi yonida yashaydi, shuning uchun u yerga borishiga bor-yo'g'i ikki daqiqa **ketadi**.

sentences.text: Reading in English is still hard. **It takes me** an hour to read ten pages.
sentences.translation: Inglizcha o'qish hali ham qiyin. O'n bet o'qishimga bir soat **ketadi**.

sentences.text: In the morning **it takes us** half an hour to get the children ready for school.
sentences.translation: Ertalab bolalarni maktabga tayyorlashimizga yarim soat **ketadi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother is a great cook. **It takes her** no time to make a big dinner.
sentences.translation: Buvim ajoyib oshpaz. Katta kechki ovqat tayyorlashiga deyarli vaqt **ketmaydi**.

sentences.text: Tom is a slow eater. **It takes him** ages to finish his lunch.
sentences.translation: Tom sekin ovqatlanadi. Tushligini tugatishiga juda ko'p vaqt **ketadi**.

sentences.text: Usually **it takes Dilnoza** about two weeks to read a novel.
sentences.translation: Odatda Dilnozaning bitta romanni o'qishiga ikki haftacha **ketadi**.

sentences.text: **It doesn't take me** long to get ready — I'm always on time.
sentences.translation: Tayyorlanishimga ko'p vaqt **ketmaydi** — doim o'z vaqtida kelaman.

examples.title: **How long did it take you** ...?
examples.description: Odam haqida savol: **How long + does / did / will + it + take + you / him / Emma + to ...?** — «... ishingizga qancha vaqt ketdi?»

sentences.text: **How long did it take you** to learn to swim?
sentences.translation: Suzishni o'rganishingizga **qancha vaqt ketdi**?

sentences.text: You've finished the puzzle! **How long did it take you**?
sentences.translation: Boshqotirmani yechibsiz! **Qancha vaqtingiz ketdi**?

sentences.text: **How long does it take you** to get to university? — About half an hour.
sentences.translation: Universitetga borishingizga **qancha vaqt ketadi**? — Yarim soatcha.

sentences.text: So, Bekzod, **how long did it take you** to write your book?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, Bekzod, kitobingizni yozishingizga **qancha vaqt ketdi**?

sentences.text: Your flat looks great. **How long did it take** to paint it?
sentences.translation: Kvartirangiz ajoyib ko'rinyapti. Uni bo'yashga **qancha vaqt ketdi**?

sentences.text: When you moved to London, **how long did it take you** to find a job?
sentences.translation: Londonga ko'chib borganingizda ish topishingizga **qancha vaqt ketdi**?

sentences.text: **Did it take** Emma long to get used to the weather in Tashkent?
sentences.translation: Emmaning Toshkent ob-havosiga ko'nikishiga **ko'p vaqt ketdimi**?

sentences.text: Mum, **how long will it take you** to make dinner? I'm starving!
sentences.translation: Oyi, kechki ovqatni tayyorlashingizga **qancha vaqt ketadi**? Qornim juda och!

sentences.text: Every morning, **how long does it take your husband** to drive to work?
sentences.translation: Har kuni ertalab eringizning ishga borishiga **qancha vaqt ketadi**?

sentences.text: Sarah, **how long did it take you** to get from the airport to the hotel?
sentences.translation: Sara, aeroportdan mehmonxonagacha yetib borishingizga **qancha vaqt ketdi**?

examples.title: **It'll take**, **It's going to take**, **It's taken**
examples.description: Boshqa zamonlar: **It'll take** / **It won't take** (kelasi), **It's going to take** (bashorat), **It's taken** (Present Perfect), **might take** (ehtimol).

sentences.text: **It'll take** about an hour to get there, so let's leave at six.
sentences.translation: U yerga yetib borishga bir soatcha **ketadi**, shuning uchun soat oltida chiqaylik.

sentences.text: Don't worry, **it won't take** long. I'll be back in five minutes.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, ko'p vaqt **ketmaydi**. Besh daqiqada qaytaman.

sentences.text: This puzzle has a thousand pieces. **It's going to take** us all weekend!
sentences.translation: Bu boshqotirmada ming bo'lak bor. Bunga butun dam olish kunlarimiz **ketadi**!

sentences.text: So far **it has taken** three years, and the school still isn't finished.
sentences.translation: Hozirgacha uch yil **ketdi**, maktab esa hali ham tugamadi.

sentences.text: With the new road, **it will only take** twenty minutes to get to Chorvoq.
sentences.translation: Yangi yo'l bilan Chorvoqqa borishga bor-yo'g'i yigirma daqiqa **ketadi**.

sentences.text: The repairs **might take** longer than we expected.
sentences.translation: Ta'mirlash biz kutgandan ko'proq vaqt **olishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: **How long will it take** to fix my car? — It depends on the problem.
sentences.translation: Mashinamni tuzatishga **qancha vaqt ketadi**? — Muammoga bog'liq.

sentences.text: Aziz is learning Japanese. **It'll take** him years to speak it well.
sentences.translation: Aziz yapon tilini o'rganyapti. Uni yaxshi gapirishiga bir necha yil **ketadi**.

sentences.text: By taxi **it'll take** less time, but it's more expensive.
sentences.translation: Taksida kamroq vaqt **ketadi**, lekin qimmatroq.

sentences.text: **It's taken** me all day to clean the flat, and I'm exhausted.
sentences.translation: Kvartirani tozalashga butun kunim **ketdi**, juda charchadim.

examples.title: **The flight takes** ...; **It doesn't take long**
examples.description: Ega harakatning o'zi bo'lishi mumkin: **The flight takes** seven hours, **Good plov takes** two hours, **Learning a language takes** years. Inkor: **doesn't / didn't / won't take** long.

sentences.text: **The flight takes** about seven hours.
sentences.translation: Parvoz taxminan yetti soat **davom etadi**.

sentences.text: **The journey** from Tashkent to Bukhara **takes** around six hours by car.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Buxorogacha mashinada yo'l olti soatcha **davom etadi**.

sentences.text: Making bread at home **takes** time, but it's worth it.
sentences.translation: Uyda non yopishga ko'p vaqt **ketadi**, lekin bunga arziydi.

sentences.text: Good plov **takes** at least two hours to cook.
sentences.translation: Yaxshi palov pishirishga kamida ikki soat **ketadi**.

sentences.text: My homework **didn't take** long today — it was easy.
sentences.translation: Bugun uy vazifamga ko'p vaqt **ketmadi** — oson edi.

sentences.text: Don't take the bus. **It doesn't take** long to walk.
sentences.translation: Avtobusga chiqmang. Piyoda borishga ko'p vaqt **ketmaydi**.

sentences.text: This form **won't take** more than five minutes to fill in.
sentences.translation: Bu shaklni to'ldirishga besh daqiqadan ortiq vaqt **ketmaydi**.

sentences.text: Learning a language **takes** years, not months.
sentences.translation: Til o'rganish oylar emas, yillar **talab qiladi**.

sentences.text: **Does** the course **take** a whole year? — No, only six months.
sentences.translation: Kurs butun bir yil **davom etadimi**? — Yo'q, faqat olti oy.

sentences.text: Our trip to Oxford **took** longer than we planned because the train broke down.
sentences.translation: Oksfordga safarimizga rejalashtirganimizdan ko'proq vaqt **ketdi**, chunki poyezd buzilib qoldi.

examples.title: Dialogue: getting to work
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki hamkasb ishga qatnash haqida gaplashadi — **How long does it take you?**, **It takes me**, **It took**, **It'll take**.

sentences.text: — Morning, Madina! You're early today. **How long does it take** you to get here?
sentences.translation: — Xayrli tong, Madina! Bugun erta keldingiz. Bu yerga kelishingizga **qancha vaqt ketadi**?

sentences.text: — Usually **it takes me** about an hour by bus.
sentences.translation: — Odatda avtobusda bir soatcha **ketadi**.

sentences.text: — An hour? That's a long time! **It only takes me** fifteen minutes.
sentences.translation: — Bir soat? Bu ko'p-ku! Menga bor-yo'g'i o'n besh daqiqa **ketadi**.

sentences.text: — Lucky you. But today I came by metro, and **it took** just thirty minutes.
sentences.translation: — Omadingiz bor. Lekin bugun metroda keldim, bor-yo'g'i o'ttiz daqiqa **ketdi**.

sentences.text: — The metro is faster. **Does it take** long to walk to the station from your house?
sentences.translation: — Metro tezroq. Uyingizdan bekatgacha piyoda borishga ko'p vaqt **ketadimi**?

sentences.text: — Not really. **It takes** about ten minutes.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas. O'n daqiqacha **ketadi**.

sentences.text: — Then the metro is better! **It'll take** you forty minutes at most.
sentences.translation: — Unda metro yaxshiroq! Ko'pi bilan qirq daqiqa **ketadi**.

sentences.text: — You're right. Yesterday **it took me** almost two hours because of the traffic.
sentences.translation: — Haqsiz. Kecha tirbandlik tufayli deyarli ikki soat vaqtim **ketdi**.

sentences.text: — Two hours! **How long did it take** you to get home, then?
sentences.translation: — Ikki soat! Unda uyga qaytishingizga **qancha vaqt ketdi**?

sentences.text: — **It took** even longer. From tomorrow, I'm taking the metro!
sentences.translation: — Undan ham ko'proq **ketdi**. Ertadan boshlab metroda yuraman!
